name: io.github.JonathanRReed/apple-system-mcp
title: Apple System
description: Read and manage macOS system settings and perform scoped desktop actions.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_SYSTEM_MCP_SAFETY_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Safety mode for system operations: safe_readonly, safe_manage, or full_access.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_SYSTEM_MCP_GUI_ALLOWED_APPS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated bundle ids of apps that GUI input tools (type, press keys, click, choose, menu) may send input to, for example com.apple.TextEdit,com.apple.Safari. Unset or empty disables GUI input. Terminals, script editors and automation apps are always refused.
